items.title: Clearer Image Insights
items.description: Photo insights use more specific visual matches. Text highlights preserve the recognized words and numbers, including short signs and multilingual text.

items.title: Keep Your Insights While Browsing
items.description: Completed insights stay available when you switch inspector tabs or return to the app. Outdated results are cleared when the image file changes.

items.title: Accurate Fit and Actual Size
items.description: Fit to Window shows the complete image, while 100% uses the correct pixel scale. Panning stays within the image bounds.

items.title: More Reliable Image Loading
items.description: Stale image updates no longer interrupt navigation. Folders with unreadable images show a clear error and Retry instead of staying stuck loading.

items.title: Easier Access to Insights
items.description: The Insights tab now stays open when the feature is off, with a clear action to enable it.
